question: At what time do departing yogis go to non-return or return?
premises: departing yogis go to non-return or return
the time for this will be spoken
non-return is liberation and return is for enjoyment
inference: the time of departure determines liberation or enjoyment
uncertainties: fused tu+anāvṛttim+āvṛttim is kept as one surface
plain_english: Departing yogis go to non-return or return; the time for this will be spoken, non-return being liberation and return being for enjoyment.
